title: Set an interval timer
remarks.text.0: If a timer with a duplicate ID is encountered, the previously set timer will be cleared
params.id: Timer ID, used to locate and delete the timer
params.args: Arguments passed to the timer callback function
returns: Whether the timer was set successfully
